description: This file implements a custom memory pooling class, SlabMemoryPool, for efficient allocation and reuse of byte blocks, designed around slab and block management to optimize memory handling in high-performance scenarios.

classes.name: SlabMemoryPool
classes.description: A custom memory pool class for handling reusable byte memory blocks, optimized with slab and block management, derived from MemoryPool<byte>.

methods.name: Rent
methods.description: Overrides MemoryPool<byte>.Rent; leases a memory block of specified size, ensuring it does not exceed block size.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements cleanup logic for disposing of all slabs and blocks when the pool is no longer needed.
